verify.cli: K=__gate_check__/$(date +%s%N); echo gate-check-$K > /tmp/__gate_check__.txt && aws s3 cp /tmp/__gate_check__.txt s3://<bucketName>/$K && aws s3 cp s3://<bucketName>/$K /tmp/__gate_check_out__.txt && cmp -s /tmp/__gate_check__.txt /tmp/__gate_check_out__.txt && aws s3 rm s3://<bucketName>/$K
verify.success_criteria: a real write, read-back with matching content, and cleanup delete all succeed -- not just that the bucket exists
verify.hardened_note: Upgraded 2026-09-05 after fix-4 testing showed the original `aws s3 ls` check would NOT have caught the S3 Object Lock collision found in tasks/task-set.json t6 -- listing a bucket succeeds even when every write/delete in it is blocked. The delete step here is specifically what would have caught it.
